correctness.rationale: Exact shear \(w=z+cx^2/2\) gives \(\dot w=b|y|-x^2\leq0\). For \(c\geq0\), \(z\leq w(0)\) and coercive energy \(E=(ax^2+y^2)/2\) obeys \(\dot E=zy^2\leq 2\max\{0,w(0)\}E\), forcing global continuation. For \(c<0\), an explicit strictly invariant polynomial escape region forces \(\dot x\geq kx^3/24\) and lifetime at most \(12/(kx(0)^2)\). Recurrence follows from strict decrease of \(w\) on every nonstationary orbit. The included checker reproduces the algebraic identities and coefficients.

value.rationale: Forward completeness versus finite-time escape is a natural nonlocal invariant relevant to well-posedness of this physical-time circuit model. The sharp c=0 boundary for the entire b<=0 sector is a genuine parameter classification, not a perturbative or textbook local deduction. An explicit trapping barrier and lifetime ceiling show why a globally decreasing polynomial scalar does not prevent finite-time escape, while invariant statistics still collapse to equilibria.
